player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ agoro a yɛfrɛ no Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Wo simma no ne '{symbol}'.
Botae no ne sɛ wo bɛsiw ano adi mmiɛnsa nnaa wɔ nkyɛmu (mpɛnpii, akyirikyiri, anaa ɛkɔ ne ɛkɔ).
Sɛ woyɛ mmiɛnsa nnaa wɔ nkyɛmu a, wobɛdii nkoguo.
Kyerɛ wo botae no wɔ krataa ase sɛ '[4]' de asie wo simma no wɔ afiri a ɛtɔ so 4.
Sɛ Player {player_id} a, wo ne '{symbol}' na wo mɛnko ne '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntotoho a enni mu. Fa '[cell]' di dwuma.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} de ne ho hyɛn ({symbol}) wɔ seli {cell}.

outcome.loss: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} sɛ odi kan yɛ adwuma a, ɔhwere!
outcome.draw: Ɛte sɛ nea obiara adi nkogu.
